_readme: Fyra doftnoter per parfym (1.0–10.0) valda ur Shopify-beskrivningens topp-/mellan-/basnoter. 'note' = exakt not från Shopify, 'visual' = hur ingrediensen ska se ut i bilden (engelska, går rakt in i prompten).

1.comment: Shopify listar bara tre noter (kardemumma, kola, amberträ). Amberträ visas därför som både amberharts och amberträ, precis som i den befintliga Noter-bilden.

ingredients.visual: a loose scatter of whole green cardamom pods with papery ridged husks, slightly faded green with pale tips, two pods split open spilling small sticky dark-brown seeds
soft golden-brown caramel toffee cubes with a slightly glossy, slightly uneven surface and rounded edges, two wrapped in crinkled clear cellophane with twisted ends and one unwrapped, no sauce
one rough chunk of translucent amber resin, honey-orange with internal cracks, cloudy patches and tiny trapped air bubbles, light glowing through its edges
a few small dark splintered amberwood chips with rough fibrous grain, resin-streaked and slightly dusty

1.backdrop: near-black charcoal brown at the top fading into warm golden amber at the bottom

ingredients.visual: three glossy dark-brown sweet chestnuts with natural streaks and a pale fibrous base, one cracked open showing the wrinkled pale golden nut inside its papery inner skin
three white sugar cubes with a coarse crystalline surface and slightly crumbled corners, a few loose sugar crystals scattered beside them
two fresh lavender sprigs with slightly wilted purple flower spikes, grey-green narrow leaves and thin stems
two dark-brown, wrinkled, slightly oily vanilla pods, one split lengthwise showing the moist black seed paste

2.backdrop: deep burnt orange-brown at the top fading into pale warm cream at the bottom
2.backdrop_source: Armani Stronger With You: bärnstensorange flaska

ingredients.visual: a real-size green-yellow bergamot with bumpy, pitted rind and one leaf, plus one half cut open showing the pale juicy segmented flesh with visible seeds
fresh lavender sprigs with slightly wilted purple flower spikes and grey-green leaves
several whole brown star anise pods with woody, slightly cracked points and a glossy seed visible in a few chambers
two dark, wrinkled, slightly oily vanilla pods, one split open showing the black seed paste

3.backdrop: deep midnight navy blue at the top fading into a lighter steel blue at the bottom
3.backdrop_source: Dior Sauvage: mörkblå gradientflaska; etikett: kompass på blått vatten

ingredients.visual: a small loose pile of deep red saffron threads, thin and wiry with a few lighter orange tips
a few fresh white jasmine flowers with slightly translucent petals, one bud, and glossy dark-green leaves with visible veins
a few translucent golden-orange amber resin chunks with rough fractured surfaces, internal cracks and light glowing through them
a small split piece of cedar wood about the size of a matchbox, with rough fibrous reddish grain, and a few thin curled cedar shavings

4.backdrop: deep ruby red at the top fading into warm golden yellow at the bottom
4.backdrop_source: Baccarat Rouge 540: rött/guld; etikett: rubin med gyllene rök

ingredients.visual: fresh lavender sprigs with slightly wilted purple flower spikes and grey-green leaves
a single purple-blue iris blossom with delicate veined petals and a yellow streak, on a green stem
one ripe green-yellow pear at real size, with russet speckles, and one pear half showing the grainy white flesh, core and dark seeds
a small chunk of Virginia cedar wood about the size of a matchbox, with rough reddish-brown heartwood, bark on one side and a few cedar shavings

5.backdrop: near-black charcoal at the top fading into cool silver grey at the bottom
5.backdrop_source: Dior Homme Intense: svart flaska med silver

ingredients.visual: a small loose mound of coarse, irregular, slightly translucent white sea salt flakes and crystals, with a few grains scattered around
a real-size green-yellow bergamot with bumpy, pitted rind and one half cut open showing the pale segmented flesh
two fresh rosemary sprigs with needle-like green leaves, silvery undersides and woody stems
a scatter of pale golden frankincense resin tears, cloudy and slightly translucent, with dusty matte surfaces

6.backdrop: deep navy at the top fading into bright ocean blue at the bottom
6.backdrop_source: Acqua di Giò Profumo: svart/djupblå flaska

ingredients.visual: a small pale cream-yellow piece of sandalwood about the size of a matchbox, with fine visible grain and slightly rough cut ends, plus a few thin sandalwood shavings
a small folded strip of natural vegetable-tanned leather with visible grain, pores and a slightly worn edge
whole green cardamom pods with papery ridged husks and a few loose sticky dark seeds
a few small purple violet flowers with delicate veined petals and green heart-shaped leaves

7.backdrop: warm caramel tan at the top fading into pale sand cream at the bottom
7.backdrop_source: Le Labo Santal 33: cremefärgad etikett; etikett: sandelträ i tan

ingredients.visual: fresh white orange blossom (neroli) flowers with slightly translucent petals, yellow stamens and glossy green leaves
a scatter of whole black peppercorns with wrinkled, matte surfaces
a single purple-blue iris blossom with delicate veined petals and a yellow streak
a small split piece of cedar wood about the size of a matchbox with rough fibrous reddish grain

8.backdrop: cool graphite grey at the top fading into pale silver white at the bottom

ingredients.visual: a real-size pink grapefruit half lying flat beside the bottle, about as wide as the bottle is tall and many times larger than the blackcurrants, showing the juicy pink-red segmented flesh with glistening juice vesicles and white pith; no whole grapefruit
a small cluster of glossy dark blackcurrants, each berry only about one centimetre, on the stem with a dusty bloom and a couple of slightly imperfect green leaves
a small knobbly fresh ginger root with papery tan skin, one end sliced showing the fibrous pale yellow interior
a few rolled cinnamon sticks with rough, layered bark texture and frayed ends

9.backdrop: near-black at the top fading into deep forest green at the bottom
9.backdrop_source: Creed Absolu Aventus: svart flaska; etikett: ryttare på grön mark

ingredients.visual: three glossy brown sweet chestnuts with natural streaks and a pale fibrous base, one cracked open showing the wrinkled roasted golden nut
a small juniper sprig with sharp green needles and dusty blue-black berries with a matte bloom
a small scatter of whole dried cloves with dark, slightly wrinkled stems and rounded heads
two dark, wrinkled, slightly oily vanilla pods, one split lengthwise

10.backdrop: deep ember red-brown at the top fading into glowing amber gold at the bottom
10.backdrop_source: Margiela By the Fireplace; etikett: lägereld i orange/gult
